actions.createVideo.description: Generate a video using a studio avatar
actions.createVideo.props.avatarId.descr: The ID of the avatar to be used for the video generation
actions.createVideo.props.script.descrip: The script to be used for the video generation
actions.createVideo.props.use_speaker_bo: Enable speaker boost for better voice quality
actions.createVideo.props.voiceId.descri: The ID of the voice to be used for the video generation
actions.createVideo.props.waitForComplet: Wait for the video generation to complete and return the video URL. If disabled, only returns the video ID.
actions.createVideo.props.webhookUrl.des: The URL to which the webhook will be sent when video generation is complete
auth.description:
To generate your API key:

1. Log in to [studio.vidlab7.com](https://studio.vidlab7.com/)
2. Click on **API** in the bottom section of the left-hand menu
3. Click the **Generate new key** button at the top right
4. Give your key a descriptive name and click **Generate**
5. Copy and store the key securely (you'll only see it once)
